_help: Copy to data/SETUP.json and fill in once per physical layout; the harness copies it into every run manifest. Change it (and say so in the notes) whenever a board is moved.
layout_photo: path of a photo of the three boards, relative to the repo (e.g. data/setup_2026-10-11.jpg)
supply: USB (VBAT about 5 V as reported by the modem)
serial_bridge: how the boards were connected to the host (direct COM port or a TCP-to-serial bridge)
